newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil Cenbank bond rate rises to 2.5445 pct.
newsitem.headline: Brazil Cenbank bond rate rises to 2.5445 pct.

text.p: Brazil's benchmark overnight rate rose to 2.5445 percent a month, from 2.5175 percent last week, at today's 6.299 billion reais sale of 56-day Central Bank Bonds (BBC), dealers said.
The auction result was in line with market expectations, they said.
The 56-day bonds will mature February 26. Today's auction is expected to add 1.201 billion reais to the banking system, with 7.5 billion reais in old bonds coming due Thursday.
The auction, usually held on Tuesdays, was held today due to the New Year holidays.
